hero.badge: The Premier Global Gathering for Sustainable Innovation
hero.heading: Accelerating the Clean Energy Transition Through Scalable Technology
hero.subheading: Join 3,500 visionary engineers, climate scientists, policymakers, and institutional investors for three days of high-impact keynotes, tactical technical workshops, and cross-sector coalition building.

paragraphs: Apex Horizon Summit was founded on the conviction that reaching global net-zero targets requires pragmatic engineering, capital mobilization, and coordinated public policy. We bring together key decision-makers across renewable energy, grid modernization, industrial decarbonization, and nature-based solutions.

Our 2027 agenda focuses on real-world deployment challenges: overcoming transmission interconnection bottlenecks, scaling long-duration energy storage, certifying carbon removal integrity, and financing critical infrastructure in emerging markets.

venue.overview: Apex Horizon Summit 2027 takes place at the Moscone Convention Center in downtown San Francisco, California. The venue is fully accessible, certified LEED Platinum, and powered entirely by renewable electricity.
logistics: Location: Moscone Convention Center, 747 Howard Street, San Francisco, CA 94103
Public Transit: Two blocks from Powell Street BART and Muni Metro Station
Accessibility: Full wheelchair accessibility, assistive listening systems, and live captioning available
Virtual Option: High-definition livestreaming and interactive Q&A available for virtual ticket holders

testimonial.quote: Apex Horizon is the single most valuable climate conference of the year. The technical depth of the presentations and the caliber of attendees make it an essential gathering for anyone serious about climate scale.
testimonial.attribution: Dr. Sarah Lindqvist, Vice President of Technology, Nordic Clean Grid Consortium
